# gws persona: Team Lead

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the Team Lead persona: a role playbook for operating an agent as a team lead — daily standups with `+standup-report` shared in team Chat, 1:1s prepared with `+meeting-prep`, emails delegated as tasks with `+email-to-task`, team OKRs tracked in a shared Sheet. Distinct from the lot 31 personas (`persona-researcher`, `persona-exec-assistant`) and from `googleworkspace-cli-persona-project-manager` in this lot (lead vs PM angle — standups, 1:1s and email delegation here). By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); the cited `gws-calendar`, `gws-gmail`, `gws-chat`, `gws-drive`, `gws-sheets` prerequisite skills come from the same repo but are not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
